name: Person A
description: Generic standing figure, neutral pose. Base character for stories.

name: Person B
description: A second generic standing figure, visually distinct from Person A (e.g. different hair or height), for two-person dialogues and stories.

name: Person (sitting)
description: A generic figure in a sitting pose, for scenes at a desk, table, or on a bus.

name: Happy face
description: A simple smiling expression, usable near a person or inside a speech/thought bubble.

name: Confused face
description: A puzzled expression, useful for showing a mistake or misunderstanding.

name: Surprised face
description: A shocked or surprised expression.

name: Sad face
description: A disappointed or unhappy expression.

name: Checkmark
description: A simple check/tick mark, for showing something correct or completed.

name: Cross / X mark
description: A simple X mark, for showing something incorrect or not done.

name: Arrow
description: A single directional arrow, can be rotated or flipped, for sequence, cause-and-effect, or before/after.

name: Question mark
description: A large question mark, for uncertainty, questions, or curiosity.

name: Exclamation mark
description: A large exclamation mark, for emphasis or surprise.

name: Speech bubble
description: An empty speech bubble for a person to 'say' something. Text or a small doodle can be placed inside it.

name: Thought bubble
description: An empty thought/cloud bubble for a person's internal thoughts.

name: Clock
description: A simple analogue clock face, for time, schedules, or duration.

name: Calendar
description: A simple calendar page or grid, for dates, days, or future plans.

name: House
description: A simple house outline, for home, locations, or stay/live scenarios.

name: Phone
description: A simple mobile phone, for calls, texting, or communication scenarios.

name: Suitcase
description: A simple suitcase, for travel, trips, or packing scenarios.

name: Book
description: A simple open or closed book, for study, reading, or learning scenarios.
